description: Compiles C sources with gcc, inside the allowed folders. Without output it only checks the code and reports warnings and errors; with output it builds a program there. For a project with a Makefile, prefer the make tool.

params.name: sources
params.description: C files separated by spaces, each starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump/src/main.c core_dump/src/modules/pi.c

params.name: output
params.description: Program to build, inside an allowed folder, e.g. core_dump/build/test; omit it to only check the code

params.name: flags
params.description: gcc flags separated by spaces, e.g. -Wall -Wextra -std=c11 -Icore_dump/src/include -lm. Allowed: -W..., -O..., -g, -std=..., -pedantic, -D..., -l..., -I<allowed folder>
